heading: Everything Helix does so your team doesn't have to.
description: A focused toolset for code-orchestration work — built around reviewable change, not autonomous chaos.

items.title: Atomic decomposition
items.description: Splits ambiguous requests into a directed graph of small, reviewable diffs you can reason about.

items.title: Convention-aware edits
items.description: Reads your repo's style, imports, and test patterns before it writes a line. No surprise refactors.

items.title: Review gate enforcement
items.description: Pauses after each atom for human review, CI green, or policy checks. You stay in control of the merge button.

items.title: Branch & PR hygiene
items.description: Creates one branch and one PR per atom with conventional titles, descriptions, and reviewers assigned.

items.title: Resumable runs
items.description: Pause, replay, or fork any atom. Every run is checkpointed so you can iterate without losing work.

items.title: Local-first execution
items.description: Runs against your real files in your real repo. No copy-paste playground, no detached cloud sandbox.
